tweets.html: I was thereTexas Storm Chasers ⚡ (@TxStormChasers)TEXAS WEATHER HISTORY 8/18: Hurricane AliciaEarly in the morning on August 18, 1983, a category 3 #hurricane with 115 MPH sustained winds made landfall near San Luis Pass and Galveston. Alicia then tracked into Alvin and the Houston metro with hurricane-force winds.Storm surge up to 12 feet struck the Bolivar Peninsula and into the Galveston Bay. The minimum central pressure dipped to 962 mb. The highest rainfall total of 9.50 inches was recorded in Liberty.Total damages from the winds, storm surge, and tornadoes caused by Alicia totaled nearly 3 billion dollars, making Alicia the costliest hurricane in Texas history at the time. Twenty-one direct deaths have been attributed to Hurricane Alicia.-Jason/TSC—  https://x.com/TxStormChasers/status/2089856216059035945

tweets.html: Astros legendMLB (@MLB)Trey Mancini has announced his retirement after 8 Major League seasons spent with the Orioles, Astros, Cubs and Angels.The 34-year-old Mancini was awarded AL Comeback Player of the Year in 2021 after missing the previous season as he battled colon cancer. He completed his triumphant return to the game by helping the Astros to a World Series championship in 2022.Congratulations on a wonderful career, Trey.
